title: Old maps show Antarctica as two islands

tellings.quote: map, but one of them shows that Antarctica actually consists of two islands that are very close together.

plain: Old world maps known as the Piri Reis map and the Oronteus Finaeus map include one that shows Antarctica as two islands lying very close together. The researcher Jason Jorjani brings this up on the show without naming a source. If true, it would mean the old mapmakers knew something about the land under Antarctica's ice.
